hooks.name: block_burn
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's BlockBurnEvent)

rust_summary: Fire about to burn a block away (`native_block_burn`).
doc_summary: Fire about to burn a block: `native_block_burn(dimension, pos, cancel)` is heard when fire's burnout check is about to remove the block at `pos`. Set `cancel` to keep it. Bundles need "hooks": @API:block_burn@.
